newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's real dips 0.01 pct in bland trade.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's real dips 0.01 pct in bland trade.

text.p: Brazil's real dipped 0.01 percent to close at 1.0454 per greenback in bland trade on the commercial foreign exchange market, dealers said.
"Everybody was just waiting for tomorrow, when the Central Bank is expected to lower the mini-band," one trader said.

The current reais-dollar mini-band was set on Tuesday between 1.0445 and 1.0495 reais to the dollar. Players are expecting a decline in the mini-band of between 0.05 percent and 0.1 percent on Friday.
So far this month, the mini-band has declined 0.53 percent. In the last few months, the mini-band was lowered between 0.50 percent and 0.65 percent.
In the interbank foreign exchange floating rate market, the real closed steady again at 1.0503 per dollar.
In the illegal parallel market, the real rose 0.28 percent to end at 1.082 per greenback, traders said.
